scientific.integrity: The period-two state is solved directly from the asynchronous scalar recurrence. A normalized two-state linearization gives an exact two-step monodromy polynomial; applying the complete second-order Jury test yields the if-and-only-if stability window.
limitations: The result concerns the n=1 asynchronous uncentered recurrence.
The objective is a deterministic scalar quadratic.
The base step is constant, unlike decaying-step convergence theorems.
The theorem classifies local orbital stability, not global attraction.

title: Exact period-two stability window for asynchronous AdaShift
